description: Assembles the user's profile, experience, career journal evidence (with a broad competency rollup), and saved CareerCompass data (if any) for recommending role titles to target. This is the inverse of get_job_fit_evidence: instead of evaluating fit for one specific job, it starts from the candidate's profile. Role taxonomy only — it does NOT validate recommendations against live job-market demand or hiring volume; that is future work. This read-only tool assembles context only; the client model produces the tiered (Strong fit / Stretch / Not recommended) recommendation.

industry_preference.description: Industry the user wants to target, if stated.

open_to_pivot.description: Whether the user is open to a role/industry pivot, if stated.

seniority.description: Seniority level the user is targeting, if stated.

name: recommend_target_roles
